method: Dense full-character component-height band in the first240 source rows; low-confidence fragmented glyphs fall back to the median for that scan year. Shrink only; keep already smaller source widths. Same width in questions and answers.
limitations: Approximate visible Chinese ink height, not CSS font size. Does not equalize smaller mathematical indices, code fonts or labels inside the original scan. Numeric screening covers798 displayed images; selected before/after previews were visually inspected.
